correctness.rationale: For Cerny automaton a:x->x+1 mod n and b:n-1->0 otherwise fixed, reverse preimages in a rotating frame give first appearances of n-1 missing states in forced predecessor order. For final singleton t, each successive productive inverse b needs at least n-1 inverse a advances, yielding |w| >= (n-1)^2+t. Equality t=0 gives unique palindrome U=b(a^{n-1}b)^{n-2}. One-letter slack only t=0 or1. Extensions aU,Ua, n-1 doubled-b insertions and (n-2)(n-3) valid nonforbidden interior splits are exhaustive, giving (n-2)^2+3. Independently counted exact reset target distributions by forward subset DP for n=2..7 and found shortest multiplicity 1, next counts [3,4,7,12,19,28]; unrestricted count rests on inverse-image proof, not finite checks.
